heading: Rule 4 — `logical` is orthogonal to `realtime`
text:
### Rule 4 — `logical` is orthogonal to `realtime` [LCAP.3.4]

`realtime: true` makes the TMS bounded (rt_locked, DS_TMS_INLINE = 16
inline IDs, withdraw_scratch pre-allocated). It does not eliminate the TMS.

`logical: false` eliminates the TMS entirely, whatever `realtime` is set
to. Together they reduce T_retract by dropping `c_tms × n_ids` and removing cascade
depth from T_wcet.  The `realtime` compliance checklist changes: the TMS
rt_locked check is replaced by "TMS absent" (LNOG.7.2).
